name: Runbook
description: A note is a runbook: each step is a command block you run by name, secrets join a step from a with-secrets group at run time, and every run is recorded under the step.

actions.label: Run this step
actions.description: Runs the step's command (its first code fence) with its secrets group, and records the run under it. An apply step is the person's, and needs confirm=<its confirm word>.

actions.label: Run the runbook
actions.description: Runs a [type::runbook] note's steps in order and stops at the first one that fails or is not an agent's to run. Records each run under its step.

secretsDir.description: Where with-secrets groups live (default ~/.config/secrets); a test points it at a scratch folder

timeoutSeconds.description: How long one step may run (default 120)
